## Core Capabilities (100% Free & Uncapped)
1. **10-Second Claude Ban Risk Audit**: Detects Datacenter/Hosting ASN IPs (Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Vultr, etc.), WebRTC real IP leaks, `Asia/Shanghai` timezone vs IP geolocation mismatches, and Claude Code telemetry exposure (`DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1`).
2. **Claude Code Zero-Ban Configuration Generator**: Generates `~/.claude/settings.json` and non-destructive CLI switcher scripts (`cc-switch.sh` / `cc-switch.ps1`) for seamless switching between Official Hardened mode, AWS Bedrock (`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1`), Google Cloud Vertex AI (`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1`), and OpenRouter while preserving `mcpServers` and `hooks`.
3. **Unlimited Manifest V3 Local Conversation & Artifact Vault**: Passively backs up unlimited `claude.ai` conversations and code blocks into local browser storage (`chrome.storage.local`), exports a 1-click "New Account Context Recovery Handoff Prompt", and supports local AES-256-GCM passphrase encryption.
